subject: South Street Historic District Preliminary Report
overview: The Commission approved a preliminary report for submission to the Massachusetts Historical Commission and planned public outreach for an upcoming hearing. The body coordinated mailings to district residents and abutters ahead of a scheduled public hearing in September.

items.title: Approval of Preliminary Report
items.summary: Approved the preliminary report prepared by Chris Skelly for submission to the Massachusetts Historical Commission.

items.title: Public Outreach and Notification Plan
items.summary: The Commission planned to mail a letter and trifold brochure to all residents and owners within the district and abutters within 300 feet.

items.title: Future Meeting and Hearing Schedule
items.summary: The body confirmed its next meeting for August 10 and scheduled a formal public hearing at City Hall for September 14.
